about: Everkind Wellness Inc. designs and develops a digital wellness platform. Its offerings, includes AI conversational Journal, an AI-powered journaling tool that prompts self-reflection and generates personalized insights; voice mode, a voice journaling capability that enables users to talk through thoughts and process emotions in real time; and AI Activities, personalized meditation, breathing, and mindfulness exercises. The company also provides AI meditation, which delivers AI-guided meditations personalized from user journal data, and AI companion, a short message service-based companion supporting on-the-go conversations, reminders, and check-ins. The company serves direct-to-consumer users seeking guided wellness and self-care, as well as enterprise customers including employers, schools, payers, providers, private institutions, and wellness programs. Everkind Wellness Inc. was formerly known as AF2 Capital Corp. and changed its name to Everkind Wellness Inc. in August 2026. Everkind Wellness Inc. was incorporated in 2022 and is based in Toronto, Canada.
